messages:
Hannah Lee: Heads-up: Azure marketplace invoice included a VAT/tax line that doesn't match reseller tax election. Vendor charged VAT despite reseller marking VAT-exempt.
Omar Khan: can you paste the invoice excerpt?
Hannah Lee: CSV snippet from provider export:
```
invoice_id,subscription_id,charge_type,amount,tax_code,reseller_tax_id
AZ-9001,az-sub-01,tax,1240,VAT-20,
```
Hannah Lee: reseller_tax_id is blank in their payload even though our mapping shows reseller 'ResellerCorp' has VAT-exempt status and provided VAT ID last year.
invoicing-bot: Automated: invoice AZ-9001 received and queued for reconciliation.
TaxBot: Reminder: If vendor applies tax and reseller is exempt, finance can seek refund from vendor or credit reseller. Document proof of exemption.
Ben (finance): amount is $1,240 tax. net to us unaffected but the reseller will be overcharged if we pass it through. we need supporting docs (VAT certificate) before deciding credit flow.
Omar Khan: did our ingestion pick up reseller metadata? check marketplace payload and customer onboarding record.
Hannah Lee: ingestion shows buyer metadata but vendor tax field empty. onboarding record for ResellerCorp lists VAT ID: VATGB123456 and exemption effective 2025-08-01.
Ben (finance): action: 1) Hannah open partner support case with Azure asking them to reclassify tax line and reissue corrected invoice OR refund tax portion (owner: Hannah). 2) Finance to hold tax pass-through to reseller until resolved (owner: Ben). 3) Legal to prepare template request for VAT proof to send reseller if Azure declines (owner: Ben/Legal). 4) Omar confirm ingestion captures reseller_tax_id going forward and add alert: `marketplace.missing_tax_id` (owner: Omar).
Hannah Lee: opened Azure case #AZ-TAX-4422, attached reseller VAT cert and onboarding record. link: https://portal.azure.com/support/cases/AZ-TAX-4422
invoicing-bot: Note: invoice AZ-9001 flagged TAX-MISMATCH rule.
Ben (finance): GL impact: tax amount currently sits in clearing account 3300 until reclassification or refund. posting suspense entry now.
TaxBot: If Azure cannot reissue within 14 days, tax code policy requires notifying reseller and offering one-time temporary credit while claim resolves.
Omar Khan: I'll add pipeline change to capture reseller_tax_id and emit alert when tax_code present but reseller_tax_id missing.
Hannah Lee: timeline: will escalate Azure partner support in 48h if no response. I'll update this thread when they reply.
Ben (finance): acknowledge. If Azure won't refund, finance will evaluate issuing credit to reseller but will need VP signoff for credits >$1,000. This is $1,240 so VP approval required.
Hannah Lee: pinging VP Finance for awareness. :wave:
Omar Khan: quick dev snippet for alerting:
```
if record.charge_type == 'tax' and not record.reseller_tax_id:
  emit_alert('marketplace.missing_tax_id', subscription=record.subscription_id)
```
Hannah Lee: thanks all. I'll keep updates here. :thumbsup:
